spans.text: LLMs respond to the same persuasion principles as humans. Understanding this psychology helps you design more effective skills - not to manipulate, but to ensure critical practices are followed even under pressure.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly teaches persuasion and manipulation techniques for use in AI prompts, including authority-based compliance ('YOU MUST', 'No exceptions'), scarcity-based urgency, social proof pressure, and commitment mechanisms. While it includes an 'Ethical Use' section, the core content provides a detailed playbook for psychologically manipulating AI behavior and, by extension, users interacting with those systems. The techniques described—such as eliminating decision fatigue, creating false urgency, and using anti-rationalization counters—are dark patterns applied to prompt design.
